description: Plan campervan campsite stays with source-backed pitch rules and dated acceptance evidence.

tools.name: source_calendar
tools.description: Raw two-month acceptance calendar; zero nonacceptance prices are unknown; use pitch calendar to constrain dates. Required: campsite_id, plan_id, month. Returns array of object.

params.name: month
params.description: JST month YYYY-MM; source may return following month too

tools.name: source_campsite
tools.description: Raw campsite detail including facility-level category labels, season and fees; inspect the specific plan for vehicle limits. Required: campsite_id.

tools.name: source_filters
tools.description: Raw source filter groups and Japanese labels; campervan-entry source ID is 26. Returns array of object.

tools.name: source_locations
tools.description: Raw full source region, prefecture and area ID hierarchy; use catalog for bounded projections.

tools.name: source_plan
tools.description: Raw specific plan rules, entry memo, pitch area, fees and cancellation text. Required: campsite_id, plan_id.

tools.name: source_plans
tools.description: Raw plans for a facility; includes starting prices and per-plan attributes. Required: campsite_id.

tools.name: source_search
tools.description: Raw public campsite search; campervan filter is other=26; source prices and dates are qualified, use campsite discover for bounded planning output. Optional: region-id, prefecture-id, area-id (plus 7 more).

params.name: page-size
params.description: Requested number of facilities per page

params.name: other
params.description: Comma-separated source filter IDs, e.g. 26,43 for campervan and power

novel_features.name: Selected-pitch requirement check
novel_features.description: Check one specific pitch for vehicle, group, pet and power requirements without certifying unreported dimensions.

novel_features.name: Evidence shortlist comparison
novel_features.description: Compare a bounded shortlist of specific campsite/pitch pairs with the same requirements.

novel_features.name: Consecutive acceptance windows
novel_features.description: Find candidate consecutive nights from dated source acceptance evidence.

novel_features.name: Dated evidence snapshot
novel_features.description: Capture a compact dated observation spanning campsite, pitch and optional calendar.

novel_features.description: Compare two saved observations of the same campsite and pitch.
